```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
#loading packages
library('dplyr')
library(haven)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(jtools)
library('interactions')
library(ltm)
library(car)

#loading data
S1 <- read.csv("~/Supplemental Study 1 Data.csv")
```

# Demographics
```{r}
S1$gender <- factor(S1$gender)
levels(S1$gender) <- c('female', 'non-binary', 'male')
S1  %>% count(gender)
describe(S1[, c("age", "Clicks")], range=TRUE)
```

#Reliability
```{r}
#Incentive salience items
RS <- as.data.frame(cbind(S1$RS1,S1$RS2, S1$RS3))
cronbach.alpha(RS, CI=FALSE)
#Prosocial motivation items
Cause <- as.data.frame(cbind(S1$Cause1,S1$Cause2, S1$Cause3))
cronbach.alpha(Cause, CI=FALSE)
```

# Preregistered regression analysis
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Standardizing PM and RS
S1$Cause <- scale(S1$Cause, scale = T)
S1$RS <- scale(S1$RS, scale = T)

##Interaction
r1 <- glm((Clicks)~RS*Cause, data=S1)
summ(r1, digit=3)

#JN point
sim_slopes(r1, pred=RS, modx = Cause, johnson_neyman = TRUE, jnplot = FALSE)

```
```{r}
#loading PROCESS script
source("C:\\Users\\yy878\\Dropbox\\Cornell PhD\\Research\\Toolbox\\process.R")
```
```{r}
process(data=S1, model=1, x="RS",y="Clicks",w="Cause", boot=5000, seed=1234, jn=1)
```

#Power
```{r}
library('sensemakr')
partial_f2(r1)
library(pwr)
pwr.f2.test(u = 3, f2 = 0.03828869 , sig.level = 0.05, power=0.8)
```


# Regression analysis using log-transformed click counts
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Regression using log-transformed click counts as the DV
rl <- glm(log(Clicks)~Cause*RS, data=S1)
summ(rl, digit=3)
#JN point
sim_slopes(rl, pred=RS, modx = Cause, johnson_neyman = TRUE, jnplot = FALSE)
```
